text:
Keisha: Quick ask  we need a compact GA ops-probe that covers: customer-facing SLA sentence, runbook link + owner, oncall alert thresholds, monitoring panel sanity, and a priced smoke test. One-line owners & acceptance criteria, please. Need sign-off by EOD.

Tom: I'll take monitoring + alerting. Acceptance: p95 < 350ms on small payloads over a 10m window, alert if 5xx > 5% in any 5m, include runbook URL in alert message, and add a temporary dashboard panel called \"GA Ops Probe\".

Victor: I'll own pricing smoke + fallback validation. Plan: 10m loadjob @ 12 qps, verify X-Cost-Tag=ga-ops in billing records, confirm fallback to quantized-small reduces p95 by >=20% if triggered. I'll attach CSV of token counts.

Keisha: I'll own runbook + SLA wording. SLA blurb to keep generic: \"Target 99.5% availability for hosted inference excluding scheduled maintenance and force majeure.\" Runbook must include exact curl snippets, expected error strings, and a 3-step rollback.

NotifyBot: Ticket created: OPS-9090 \"GA ops-probe and handoff\" assigned to Keisha, Tom, Victor due EOD.

Tom: Ack. I'll run the burnin at 15:00 UTC and post snapshots. Quick oncall snippet I'll add to the runbook: 
``` 
if rate(5xx,5m) > 5% then page SRE-primary
if token_reject_rate(10m) > 10% then page model-team
on alert include: runbook_url, last_5m_error_sample
```

Victor: Ack. Pricing commands I'll run: 
```
loadgen --qps 12 --dur 10m --route /v1/generate --payload-size 128
billing-audit --window 15m --filter X-Cost-Tag=ga-ops
```
I'll validate meterIDs and token totals and attach results to OPS-9090. Expected error strings to capture: \"model_kv_overflow\" and \"quota_exceeded_token_limit\".

Keisha: Drafted runbook at internal://docs/runbooks/ga-ops-probe.md (placeholder). Included curl snippets and the rollback steps. Waiting on Victor's token CSV and Tom's Grafana snapshots to finish.

(15:12) Tom: Burnin complete. p95=295ms except a 40s spike at 15:05 that auto-fallbacked. Alert fired and contained runbook link. Grafana snapshot attached to OPS-9090.

(15:30) Victor: Pricing smoke done. Billing records include X-Cost-Tag and token counts match loadgen. Fallback triggered once and reduced p95 by 27%. CSV uploaded to OPS-9090.

Keisha: Runbook updated with the exact error strings and timeline entries from Tom/Victor. Added a 1-paragraph TL;DR for sales/support and the curl examples.

Keisha: Final step  please react with :white_check_mark: when your area is complete and I'll assemble the handoff note to sales/support and close OPS-9090.

Tom: :white_check_mark:

Victor: :white_check_mark:

Keisha: :white_check_mark: (handbook committed)
